evidence_items.title: Jamie-nus/TOPO-Bench
evidence_items.summary: TOPO-Bench: topological localization under perceptual aliasing TOPO-Bench tests whether a robot that has mapped a place can tell where it is after being moved without knowing it, when other places in the map look alike. A system builds a map from a mapping traversal. It is then dropped into a test traversal without odometry for the first frame, follows it, and at the last test frame must either name the map place it is at or abstain because that place is not in the map. evidence_items.title: Yeongtak/PReMind-Bench
evidence_items.summary: PReMind-Bench PReMind-Bench is the benchmark from PReMind: When Personal Memory Meets Visual Hazards (arXiv:2611.23808). An agent decides whether to request personal memory, then answers the request from the scene image and available personal evidence. Evaluation only. This repository contains the test split only; use it for evaluation, not for training or model selection.
